meta.title: Fireplace Repair Toronto | Northmark Chimney
meta.description: Fireplace repair in Toronto & the GTA: fireboxes, dampers, smoke chambers and gas fireplaces. Free inspection, photos, and the price before any work.

hero.p: Cracked firebox panels, crumbling mortar, a damper that won’t seal, a gas fireplace that won’t light or stay lit. We work on the part of the system you actually sit in front of — wood-burning and gas.

signs.p: Look inside the firebox with a flashlight. These are the things to notice.
signs.p-2: Cracks let heat reach parts of the house they shouldn’t.
signs.p-3: Joints wear out from years of heat and need repacking.
signs.p-4: Stuck, rusted or missing — heat escapes all winter.
signs.h3-4: A Gas Fireplace That Won’t Stay Lit
signs.p-5: Or won’t light at all. Tell us the make if you know it.
signs.p-6: The fireplace isn’t drawing properly. It could be the damper, the smoke chamber or the flue.
signs.p-7: Moisture is getting in from above.
signs.p-8: Not sure which one you’re seeing? That is what the free inspection is for. Book it here or call {{site.phone}}.

how.p: Every visit starts with protecting your home and ends with photos and a clean work area.
how.p-2: Firebox, damper and, for gas units, the components — with photos of anything worn or unsafe.
how.p-3: Floors and the room around the fireplace covered; loose material removed.
how.p-4: Joints repacked with refractory mortar, panels or damper replaced, gas components serviced as needed.
how.p-5: Everything checked in operation before we leave, and the area cleaned.

faq.q: Do you work on gas fireplaces?
faq.p-2: Yes. Tell us about your setup when you book — the make if you know it, and what it is doing or not doing — and we’ll confirm it is a fit before anything is booked.
faq.q-2: Can you repair a cracked firebox?
faq.p-3: Yes — firebox mortar joints and panels. We show you the damage first and price it before any work.
faq.q-3: My damper won’t close. Can you fix it?
faq.p-4: Yes — dampers that are stuck, rusted or missing can be repaired or replaced.
faq.q-4: Should I use the fireplace until it’s fixed?
faq.p-5: If the firebox is cracked or smoke is coming into the room, we’d rather you didn’t until it has been looked at. The inspection is free.
faq.q-5: How much does fireplace repair cost?
faq.p-6: It depends on what is worn or damaged, so we price it after the free inspection — at your home, before any work starts.
